mapper.insert:
insert into monitor_metric_sample (metric_category, metric_name, metric_scope, metric_value, metric_unit, tag_json, service_id, service_ip_port, sample_time, create_time) values
(#{item.metricCategory}, #{item.metricName}, #{item.metricScope}, #{item.metricValue}, #{item.metricUnit}, #{item.tagJson}, #{item.serviceId}, #{item.serviceIpPort}, #{item.sampleTime}, now())
mapper.select: select distinct service_id as serviceId, service_ip_port as serviceIpPort from monitor_metric_sample where service_id is not null and service_id != '' order by service_id
